messages:
Ava (PM): quick sync: we need a trimmed observability pilot for console that prioritizes cost visibility + safe tracing. proposal: "Observe Lite" - small card + sampled traces + pilot privacy controls.
Priya (Eng-SRE): +1. must-haves: tenant kill-switch, redaction on traces, sampling circuit-breaker.
Marco (Eng): implementation sketch: host hook emits minimal metadata unless sampled. header X-Req-Trace for propagation. cheap fast-path when not sampled.
Lina (Data): cost estimator: map model+tokens -> USD approximate. Top-5 routes target <12% error. aggregation levels: route, service, org.
Jonah (Design): UI: compact card with three micro-metrics: 24h cost delta, error spike indicator, p95 latency. drilldown shows route table and a trace peek.
Maya (Support): pilot ask: include a plain-language privacy sheet for customers explaining trace redaction. I can own that doc.
Ava (PM): rollout plan: internal -> 2-customer pilot -> GA opt-in. gating: trace pipeline success >99%, CPU uplift <3%, cost accuracy for top routes.
Priya (Eng-SRE): alert draft: if trace_emits_errors >0.005 for 5m then auto-disable sampling and page SRE.
Marco (Eng): I'll push a PoC with header & scrubber today.
Ava (PM): owners: Marco trace hook, Priya gating, Lina cost validation, Jonah UI, Maya customer comms. Ack with :thumbsup:.
All: :thumbsup:
